name: Bait
body:
School enchantment (compulsion); Level bard 4, druid 2, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, M (small mundane item)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target person who sees it first (see below)
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

When this enchantment is placed upon a mundane item, the first person who sees it must make a Will save. Failure makes the victim experience an overwhelming desire to possess the enchanted item, causing him to move immediately toward it, ignoring all dangers. While under the influence of this spell, the victim is considered flat-footed and fights at a -4 attack penalty.
